title: Tamale pie
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning or 2 tbsp chili powder + cumin
1 15-oz can diced tomatoes or enchilada sauce
1 box corn muffin mix plus egg and milk as directed
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Brown beef and onion; stir in seasoning, corn, and tomatoes. Simmer 5 minutes.
Spread in a baking dish. Scatter cheese.
Mix cornbread batter and spread on top.
Bake until cornbread is golden and set, 20–25 minutes.
